newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Somague shares surge after acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Somague shares surge after acquisition.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese civil engineering group Somague rose 10 percent to 1,895 escudos as the Lisbon market welcomed news of the acquisition of A.Silva & Silva's Assiconstroi building subsidiary, dealers said.
"For now, 1,900 escudos seems to be a good resistance level for Somague, but the market could push the shares higher," said one dealer.
Another said: "The market is pleased by the financial strategy adopted by Somague to buy Assiconstroi."

Somague has said it will raise its capital by five billion escudos and issue 3.5 billion escudos of debt to finance its purchase of Assiconstroi. The value of the deal, announced on Monday, was 8.25 billion escudos.
Somague shares stood at 1,890 escudos, up 170, in volume of 87,447 shares at 1525 GMT. A.Silva & Silva shares were down five escudos to 1,625 in volume of 2,000 shares.
